# pi-lsp, Prism fork

Fork (roadmap R7.7f, owner's go on 2026-10-21) of the published npm package `@narumitw/pi-lsp` 0.49.8
(`sha512-Djrm0BBmbITmKUv2OtrPUACbP2j1GA7DQ4n/P/mZLf++s6Vv4fMMJUPvrQ01UtnaIQ7XzMCKzWrOyrJatyOGSw==`,
https://github.com/narumiruna/pi-extensions, `packages/pi-lsp/`, MIT). The files are the published
package with small patches in `dist/index.ts`, each marked `// prism-fork:`; `src/` is the published
source, unchanged and not loaded.

Its dependencies resolve from `../../node_modules/` (see `../../README.md`).

## Changes from 0.49.8

| Change | Files | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Registers a session-owned status reader for the native GUI inspector; reads the same runtime/trust/switches as `/lsp`, returns names, commands, readiness and config notices, and removes the reader at shutdown. No server is started and no environment values are returned | `dist/index.ts` (`session_start`, `session_shutdown`), `prism.registerLspInspector` host symbol | Keep the native inspector tied to the loaded fork rather than reconstructing its configuration or parsing its notifications |
| Code-action edits are checked before use: `newText` must be a string and every position a pair of non-negative integers, with the end not before the start. Otherwise `lsp_fix` fails and the file is not written. Line starts are found once per file instead of once per edit | `dist/index.ts` (`positionTextEdits`, `isTextPosition`, `lineStartsOf`, `offsetFromLineStarts`) | With `write: true`, a malformed edit wrote `undefined` or `[object Object]` into the file, a reversed range duplicated content, a `NaN` position deleted the prefix, a negative character went back to the previous line (probe, 2026-10-21) |
| Server output is joined once a message is complete instead of on every chunk; a header without its blank line is refused past 64 KiB | `dist/index.ts` (`LspClient#onData`) | Reading was quadratic: 1 MB in 91 ms, 8 MB in 456 ms, 32 MB in 4.3 s, with the TUI frozen meanwhile |
| Each server can be turned off in `/settings` > Servers (owner's go, 2026-10-21): the names are kept in the global `settings.json` (`lsp.disabled`), not in `pi-lsp.json`; `loadRuntime` leaves them out, `/lsp` lists them as off, and `session_start` adds the section through `registerLspSettings` from the harness | `dist/index.ts` (import, `loadRuntime`, `/lsp`, `session_start`, `session_shutdown`) | pi-lsp has no per-server switch, and a `pi-lsp.json` replaces its whole catalog, so writing one to turn a server off would drop the others (V2.56) |
| `/lsp` says which servers are ready, which are turned off, and how many are not installed, in the harness's words (`lspStatusSummary`, translated), at info level; `/lsp all` keeps the list of each server's command and status | `dist/index.ts` (import, `/lsp`) | `/lsp` showed two lines for each of about forty servers, most of them "command missing", as a warning (owner's QA of fork.8, UX-06) |
| Each server starts in the session's sandbox (`lspSpawn` from the harness), with the project as its folder, its network behind the relay, and the real Git folders read-only; a broken sandbox refuses it, and a root outside the project is refused while the sandbox is on. Without a sandbox, the harness's gate asks first, as a dangerous action. `root` defaults to the session's folder, and a relative `root` resolves from it | `dist/index.ts` (import, `LspClient`, `withLspClient`, the two `resolveRoot` calls) | A language server runs code the project controls (rust-analyzer builds `build.rs` and procedural macros); it ran in Prism's own process with the whole home folder (code review of 2026-11-01, C2, A8, L8) |
| The status line's activity (`fix`), the `LSP config ignored` notice and the `/lsp all` list go through `prism.translateUi` (fork.10, R4.14); server names, commands and tool results stay as published | `dist/index.ts` (`prismUi`, `withLspClient`, `/lsp` handler) | Shown texts in the harness's language; English without Prism |
| A server's stderr keeps its last 64 KiB; a message announced over 64 MiB is refused before its body is gathered, and nothing more is read from a server whose output is refused (it is stopped); `startLspClientForTest` starts a client for the test | `dist/index.ts` (`LspClient` stderr and `#onData` handlers, `startLspClientForTest`, `export`) | A chatty server or a huge `Content-Length` grew Prism's memory without bound (Codex review of 2026-11-09, CR-036) |
| Overlapping code-action edits are found by sorting replacements and finding, by binary search, the one replacement each insertion could fall in, instead of comparing every pair; the same edits are refused as before | `dist/index.ts` (`hasOverlappingTextEdits`) | The check was quadratic and synchronous: 50 000 insertions took 2.3 s, 100 000 took 9.9 s (8 and 16 ms now, measured) |
| With `write: true`, `lsp_fix` writes only if the file still has the text the server analysed, checked in the queue the edit and write tools use; otherwise it fails and asks to run it again | `dist/index.ts` (import, `runFix`) | The edits were computed on the text read before the analysis and written over an edit made meanwhile (Codex review of 2026-11-09, CR-035) |
| Code-action positions use the protocol's line terminators (LF, CRLF and CR) and stop a column past the content before the terminator, in one line table shared by `positionAt` and the edits | `dist/index.ts` (`lineTableOf`, `positionAt`, `offsetFromLineTable`, `positionTextEdits`) | An insertion past the end of a CRLF line split the CR from its LF, and an edit on the second line of a CR-only file landed at the end of the file (Codex review of 2026-11-09, CR-370) |
| `initialize` announces CodeAction literals (`codeActionLiteralSupport` with the standard kinds) and `dataSupport`; bare Commands are not sent to `codeAction/resolve`, and when the server answers only with Commands `lsp_fix` fails with an explicit error and leaves the file alone | `dist/index.ts` (`LspClient` `initialize`, `resolveActions`, `runFix`) | A conforming server answers a client without literal support with Commands, which `lsp_fix` cannot run: every fix was dropped and reported as no change (Codex review of 2026-11-09, CR-372) |
| The root check refuses only the exact `..` segment and `../` prefixes, so a file such as `..generated.ts` at the root is inside it | `dist/index.ts` (`isInsidePath`) | Any name starting with `..` was refused as outside the workspace (Codex review of 2026-11-09, CR-373) |

## Updating

Diff the new published package against the 0.49.8 tarball, apply the upstream changes to this
copy, and re-apply every `// prism-fork:` patch. `test/fork-lsp-fuzz.test.ts` checks the first two changes, `test/fork-settings-lot4.test.ts` the switches and the summary of `/lsp`, `test/fork-review-2026-11-01.test.ts` the sandbox.
